title: C++ Files and Streams
description: Reading and writing files with <fstream>: open modes, formatted and unformatted I/O, positioning, error states and RAII cleanup.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 使用 <fstream> 讀寫檔案：開啟模式、格式化與非格式化輸入輸出、檔案定位、錯誤狀態，以及 RAII 資源清理。

questions.prompt: Which standard header declares std::ifstream and std::ofstream?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個標準標頭檔宣告了 std::ifstream 與 std::ofstream？

explanation.zh-Hant: <fstream> 定義檔案串流型別；<iostream> 只提供主控台串流，<cstdio> 是 C 的檔案 API，<filesystem> 處理路徑與目錄。

questions.explanation: <fstream> defines the file stream types. <iostream> only provides the console streams, <cstdio> the C file API, and <filesystem> path and directory utilities.

questions.prompt: You construct `std::ofstream out("log.txt");` for a file that already contains text. What happens by default?

prompt.zh-Hant: 對一個已有內容的檔案建構 `std::ofstream out("log.txt");`，預設會怎樣？

a.zh-Hant: 檔案被截斷，原有內容被捨棄

b.zh-Hant: 新內容附加在原有內容之後

c.zh-Hant: 建構失敗，因為檔案已存在

explanation.zh-Hant: ofstream 的單一參數建構函式等於 `ios::out | ios::trunc`，會清空既有檔案；若要附加內容，需加上 `std::ios::app`。

options.text: The file is truncated: existing contents are discarded.
New text is appended after the existing contents.
The constructor fails because the file exists.

questions.explanation: The single-argument ofstream constructor opens with `ios::out | ios::trunc`, so an existing file is emptied. Add `std::ios::app` to append instead.

questions.prompt: A newly constructed std::ifstream does not throw by default when the file is missing, so you should test `is_open()` or the stream state.

prompt.zh-Hant: 新建構的 std::ifstream 在檔案不存在時預設不會拋出例外，因此應檢查 `is_open()` 或串流狀態。

explanation.zh-Hant: 預設建構的 ifstream 不會因開檔失敗而拋出例外，只會設定 `failbit`。讀取前應檢查 `is_open()`（或 `if (!in)`），或呼叫 `in.exceptions(std::ios::failbit)` 要求拋出。

questions.explanation: The default constructor opens with exceptions disabled; failure only sets failbit. Check `is_open()` (or `if (!in)`) before reading, or call `in.exceptions(std::ios::failbit)` to opt into throwing.

questions.prompt: The `>>` operator reads whitespace-delimited tokens, while std::getline reads an entire line including spaces.

prompt.zh-Hant: `>>` 運算子讀取以空白分隔的單元，而 std::getline 讀取包含空白的整行。

explanation.zh-Hant: `in >> word` 會略過前導空白並在下一個空白停止；`std::getline(in, line)` 讀到換行字元為止（並移除它）。兩者混用時常會留下未處理的換行字元。

questions.explanation: `in >> word` skips leading whitespace and stops at the next whitespace character, while `std::getline(in, line)` consumes everything up to '\n' and removes it. Mixing the two often leaves a newline behind.

questions.prompt: Which of these are valid std::ios open-mode flags? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是有效的 std::ios 開啟模式旗標？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: 標準旗標是 `in`、`out`、`app`、`ate`、`trunc`、`binary`。沒有 `append` 這個旗標，附加要用 `std::ios::app`。

questions.explanation: The standard open-mode flags are in, out, app, ate, trunc and binary. There is no `append` flag; the correct name for appending is `std::ios::app`.

questions.prompt: Which statements about RAII and file streams are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列關於 RAII 與檔案串流的敘述，哪些正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 區域的 std::ofstream 會在解構函式中關閉檔案，即使例外展開堆疊也一樣

b.zh-Hant: 明確呼叫 close() 可提早關閉，並檢查最後一次沖刷是否失敗

c.zh-Hant: 讓串流在程式結束時才關閉，是沖刷緩衝資料的唯一方法

d.zh-Hant: 兩個執行緒可以安全地同時寫入同一個 std::ofstream，不需同步

explanation.zh-Hant: 解構函式會先沖刷再關閉檔案，因此作用域結束或堆疊展開都會釋放檔案；若想在作用域結束前得知最後一次沖刷失敗，仍應主動呼叫 close()。串流物件本身不是執行緒安全的，多執行緒寫入需自行加鎖。

options.text: A local std::ofstream closes its file in its destructor, even when an exception unwinds the stack.
Calling close() explicitly lets you close early and check whether the final flush failed.
Leaving the stream to close at process exit is the only way to flush buffered data.
Two threads may safely write to the same std::ofstream without synchronization.

questions.explanation: The destructor flushes and then closes, so scope exit and stack unwinding both release the file; call close() when you want to detect a failed final flush before the scope ends. Stream objects are not thread-safe, so concurrent writes need external locking.

questions.prompt: To open a file for binary I/O, combine std::ios::out with std::ios::____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 要以二進位方式開啟檔案，需把 std::ios::out 與 std::ios::____ 結合。

explanation.zh-Hant: `std::ios::binary` 會關閉部分平台在文字模式下做的換行轉換，使位元組原樣保留。

questions.explanation: `std::ios::binary` disables the newline translation that text mode performs on some platforms, so bytes round-trip unchanged.

questions.prompt: A std::fstream is used for both reading and writing. Which function moves the read position, which moves the write position, and how do you read the current read position?

prompt.zh-Hant: std::fstream 同時用於讀與寫。哪個函式移動讀取位置、哪個移動寫入位置？又如何取得目前的讀取位置？

model.zh-Hant: seekg 移動 get（讀取）位置，seekp 移動 put（寫入）位置。tellg 與 tellp 分別回傳目前位置（型別為 std::streampos），例如 `in.seekg(0, std::ios::end); auto size = in.tellg();` 可取得檔案大小。

explanation.zh-Hant: get 代表輸入、put 代表輸出；tell 系列回報位置，狀態不良時回傳 -1。

answer.model: seekg moves the get (read) position and seekp moves the put (write) position. tellg and tellp return the corresponding positions as std::streampos, so `in.seekg(0, std::ios::end); auto size = in.tellg();` gives the file size.

questions.explanation: get means input and put means output; the tell functions report positions and return -1 when the stream state is not good.

questions.prompt: Which call correctly performs an unformatted binary read of one object into `value`?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個呼叫能正確地把一個物件以非格式化二進位方式讀入 `value`？

c.zh-Hant: `in >> value` 會讀取原始二進位內容

explanation.zh-Hant: `read` 需要 `char*` 與位元組數，因此要把物件位址轉型為 `char*`；格式化的 `>>` 解析的是文字，不是原始位元組。

options.text: `in >> value` reads the raw binary representation.

questions.explanation: `read` takes a `char*` plus a byte count, so the object's address must be cast to `char*`. Formatted `>>` parses text, not raw bytes, and no implicit conversion exists from `T*` to `char*`.

questions.prompt: After a read hits end-of-file and sets failbit and eofbit, which call makes the same stream usable again?

prompt.zh-Hant: 讀取遇到檔尾並設定了 failbit 與 eofbit 之後，呼叫哪個函式才能讓同一個串流再次使用？

explanation.zh-Hant: `clear()` 會重設狀態旗標；在失敗狀態下 `seekg` 與後續讀取都會被忽略。呼叫 `clear()` 後再 `seekg(0)` 才能重新讀取。

questions.explanation: `clear()` resets the state flags. While the stream is in a failed state, `seekg` and further reads are ignored, so you must clear the state before seeking back and reading again.
